title: CCTV shows BJP MLA's daughter slapping cop at Karnataka temple

The MLA apologized for his daughter's conduct and called for a departmental inquiry.

title: 'State tried to airbrush Imran Khan out': Atherton on appeal for ex-Pakistan PM

Atherton raised alarms about the efforts to diminish Khan's status, while Kapil Dev advocated for the essential rights of prisoners, urging for adequate healthcare and dignity without interfering in judicial processes.

title: Anthropic's job interview has one question you cannot prepare for

Every applicant also faces a culture interview that asks whether they would accept the stock going to zero for safety reasons, as CEO Dario Amodei worries new hires are joining for money over mission.

title: 'Not integral to Islam': HC junks UP girl's plea for allowing hijab in school
content: Allahabad High Court dismissed a student's plea for wearing a headscarf with her uniform.  The court found no evidence that headscarves are an essential religious practice in Islam.  Photographs showed no other students, even from the same community, wore headscarves.  The bench noted a lack of factual foundation to support the claim of religious necessity.  Previous High Court opinions also stated headscarves are not integral to Islam.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125m school to shut after 10 yrs
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution for low-income families, has closed its doors after a decade. Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, prompting the board's unanimous decision to shut down. While offering extensive support services, the school's academic results did not meet state benchmarks. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is providing financial support for the transition and educational savings accounts.

title: Ex-Australia star picks 'perfect' coach for Chennai Super Kings

title: Hidden Antarctic lake drained 2 cubic km of water in just three years
content: Scientists discovered active subglacial lakes beneath Antarctica's ice sheet. NASA satellite data revealed ice surface changes indicating water movement. These hidden lakes were found to fill and drain over short periods. This dynamic water system influences ice stream speeds and mass balance. The findings showed a hidden, active world beneath the frozen continent.

title: Sridhar Vembu shares why giving employees more freedom can feel ‘chaotic’

He highlights that organizations can choose to provide a structured environment, which may lead to passive behavior, or encourage proactive engagement, albeit with potential for conflict. Vembu emphasizes that striking a balance between being decisive and promoting initiative is crucial for a harmonious workplace dynamic.

title: Dera chief Ram Rahim walks out of jail again, gets 21-day furlough in 17th release
content: Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh has received another 21-day parole from jail.  He is currently serving a 20-year sentence for rape convictions.  This marks his seventeenth parole release since 2020.  Prison rules allow convicts up to ten weeks of parole annually.  His repeated releases have drawn significant public scrutiny and attention.

title: SUV on rampage kills 71-year-old woman in Delhi; hits several vehicles

Shashi Bhateja, 71, tragically lost her life at Moolchand Hospital, while her husband suffered a fracture and serious eye injuries. The driver was apprehended at the scene for further investigation.

title: ‘Demands unmet’: CJP calls march on Sept 5

title: Heavy rain lashes Delhi-NCR; Gurgaon offices, schools shift to online mode

Widespread waterlogging and traffic snarls significantly disrupted daily life across the capital.  Civic agencies focused on drainage clearing and urgent road restoration work.  Residents faced similar flooding situations just weeks earlier.

title: 'What do you think of yourself?': Ex-Pak cricketer responds to ‘worst team’ tag

Butt highlighted England's diverse player origins while defending Pakistan's homegrown talent. England secured a significant innings victory over Pakistan in the first Test. This defeat marked a new era for the English team after coaching changes.

title: Rupee slips to 95.74 against US dollar as crude prices, importer demand weigh

The Reserve Bank of India stepped in to stabilize the currency, keeping its fluctuations minimal. Meanwhile, domestic equities opened softly, although foreign institutional investors maintained their purchasing momentum in the stock market.

title: Karnataka suspends Amazon, Instamart, BigBasket licences over 'datura' sale
content: Karnataka authorities suspended food licences for Amazon, Swiggy Instamart, and BigBasket.  Toxic datura fruits and seeds were found sold as food products on these platforms.  The department ordered immediate removal of all datura listings and advertisements.  Selling and distributing datura as food poses a serious public health risk.  Consumption of unpurified datura can lead to coma and death in extreme cases.

title: Mumbai only Indian city in global Work From Anywhere Index, ahead of London, Miami

As India's flexible workspace market expands rapidly, this city leads in Asia. The increasing adoption of Work From Anywhere policies has inspired many to combine travel with work, resulting in longer vacations to accommodate remote tasks.

title: In 1981, Sudha Murty lent Rs 10,000 to start Infosys: Their enduring bond

Vice President JD Vance supports the proposal, emphasizing hiring American workers. Indian professionals, a major beneficiary group, could be significantly impacted by this change. The public has thirty days to submit comments on this proposed rule.

content: the number of Indian students seeking admission to US colleges fell by 15% in 2025-26 compared with the previous year . the decline comes even as overall undergraduate application numbers for the 2026-27 academic year increased . international applications, however, moved in the opposite direction .

title: In 1998, Justin Trudeau's younger brother was swept away in an avalanche
content: the family was hit by an insurmountable tragedy in 1998 when Michel Truedau, the younger son of former prime minister, died in an avalanche . on November 13, 1998, Michel went on a skiing trip in the Kokanee Glacier Park, BC, with his friends . his body was never found .

title: In 1926, a 10-foot rocket rose just 41 feet from a Massachusetts farm
content: physicist Robert H. Goddard set up a slim, 10-foot rocket he nicknamed Nell on a launch frame in an open field . fueled by gasoline and liquid oxygen, the rocket climbed just 41 feet into the air, flew for only 2.5 seconds, and crashed back to earth 184 feet from where it started .

title: Georgia island hogs descended from Spanish pigs now help scientists study obesity
